_sheet: First-person arms. The arms mesh, posed by Bodycam's animations, holds the gun; the camera sits at a bone of the same skeleton.

_columns.materials: bodycam path list, one per mesh section in order
_columns.camera_bone: bone the camera sits at (its position only)
_columns.camera_offset_cm: x y z added to that position, Unreal component axes (y forward, z up)
_columns.gun_bone: bone the gun's origin sits on, rotation included

rows.verified: autotest 2026-10-26: arms with their textures hold the Glock and the M4A1 in first person
